title: Angular Momentum of a Flying Bird
body: A bird flies overhead from where you stand at an altitude of $$300.0\, \text{m}$$ and at a speed horizontal to the ground of $$20.0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$. $$The$$ $$bird$$ $$has$$ $$a$$ $$mass$$ $$of$$ $$2.0\, \text{kg}$$. $$The$$ $$radius$$ $$vector$$ $$to$$ $$the$$ $$bird$$ $$makes$$ $$an$$ $$angle$$ $$\theta$$ with respect to the ground. The radius vector to the bird and its momentum vector lie in the xy-plane.
